display.purpose: Public product statements and consequential operating outcomes.

body.purpose: Product copy, records, forms, and dense operational data.

shadows.name: published-medium
shadows.purpose: Drawers, dialogs, and active media surfaces.

narrative.overview: Documentary infrastructure imagery and editorial public pages transition into a dense operating picture without changing the CorvaUI component vocabulary.

rules.name: The Published Palette Rule
rules.body: Never declare or override a CorvaUI color token in application CSS.

rules.name: The Working Surface Rule
rules.body: Shadows are reserved for active overlays and transient hierarchy.

dos: Do use concept-light and concept-dark exactly as published.
Do keep public storytelling and operational workflows complete on mobile.
donts: Don't turn the product into a generic dashboard or decorative card grid.
Don't override or recreate CorvaUI theme colors or controls.
